description: Retro experiment inputs for a delivered sprint (src/test/experimentWorld.ts `reported`): tickets 1-3 accepted and a first report revision with a prose retro, whose scorecard is sealed. {{tokens}} are filled from that world (`tokens`): sprintId, runId, ticket1 and attempt1 name the run's records; sourceReport is the first report revision and sprintAssessment/runAssessment/ticketAssessment are grades of its sealed scorecard; earlierReport/earlierAssessment are the report revision holding an earlier experiment and the grade it cites; legacyReport is a report from before scorecards. `valid` is a complete experiment drawn from the sprint grade of the scorecard frozen with the very report that carries it (source by subject). Each case submits a report whose retro is `retro`, where the string "$valid" stands for the valid experiment and an object { "$valid": patch } for the valid experiment with `patch` merged in (a null value removes the key). `expect` is rejected (with `error`, a substring of the message), accepted, or normalized (accepted, and `stored` says how the retro is stored).

issue.summary: Sprint 1 took 70 minutes of active time across three medium tickets.

valid.hypothesis: Hypothesis: the tickets were sized without the importer context, so workers re-read it each time.

proposedWork.body: Add one paragraph to the planner skill naming the importer's record files.
